items.title: Delhi Police moved detained leaders Ranka, Das (and others) out of Jaffarpur Kalan PS ~2:30 AM; destination unknown
items.summary: Nighttime transfer: Delhi Police escorted CJP leaders including Ashutosh Ranka and Sourav Das out of the Jaffarpur Kalan police station at ~2:30 AM and loaded them into a white tourist van as a crowd filmed; on-screen text asks where police took them. Both The Lallantop's on-the-ground team and the MaatiTak reel independently captured the 2 AM move. Whereabouts now unknown — watch for release vs transfer/production before magistrate.
items.source_name: MaatiTak (@officialmaatitak) IG reel; corroborated by The Lallantop (India Today Group) ground report
